scenes.headline: How one coding-agent session does an ML harness's job
scenes.sub: A shell, a clock and a submission box, for a whole day
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Caraway! Today: how a single coding agent session, left alone for a day, does the work that machine learning harnesses used to hard-code.

scenes.text: Give a strong model a shell, the time left and a place to register submissions, and it runs the search a harness used to impose.
scenes.mark: it runs the search a harness used to impose
scenes.say: Give a strong model a shell, the time left, and a place to register submissions. It runs the search itself.

left.title: Harness
left.say: The usual harness wraps the model in search trees, teams of agents and memory layers, because a chat call cannot run its own code.

right.title: Malena
items: One session for the whole budget
right.say: Malena is one coding agent session for the whole budget, with a shell, a clock and a submission registry.

steps.say: The agent starts in a folder with the data, and explores it with its own tools.
It writes code and launches training runs in the background on one GPU.
Each candidate goes into a registry with the score from the agent's own validation split.
When it stops early, the harness only says how much time is left. That is the whole orchestration.

scenes.title: The ladder, one rung at a time
scenes.say: The paper climbs a ladder at a fixed model, GPU and budget.

items.say: A chat call writes a whole script, blind.
One agent session with a shell. This is the biggest jump.
Chaining sessions under four search rules. None beats the others.
One session for the whole day. Best medal rate.
Adding subagents or parallel peers. Nothing improves on it.

scenes.title: Three agents with broadcast, 14 hard tasks
scenes.note: the good submission was there; picking it failed

scenes.text: With a strong model, start with one long session and spend the effort on choosing the final submission, not on orchestration.
scenes.say: With a strong model, start with one long session, and spend your effort on choosing the final submission, not on orchestration.

recap: A shell is the biggest single gain
One long session beats search trees
scenes.say: A shell is the big gain. One long session beats search trees. More agents broke the choice of answer.
